Skills that form {c_important}{u}Ice Spikes{/u}{/c} deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage. 

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} chance to form an exploding {c_important}{u}Ice Spike{/u}{/c}, dealing {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} Cold damage.
